name: Tool — Logic Apps
summary: AzureStandardLogicAppTool: invoke an Azure Logic App workflow from a BYOM-routed agent.
description: `AzureStandardLogicAppTool` lets a Prompt Agent invoke an Azure Logic Apps workflow while the host orchestrator model is BYOM-routed. It would let users trigger workflow automation from a gateway-backed agent.
notes:
Not yet confirmed against Foundry for BYOM routing. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/tools/connectors. See `test.py` for the `LOGIC_APP_RESOURCE_ID` and `LOGIC_APP_WORKFLOW_NAME` probe.

Logic Apps is not in the official BYOM-supported tools list: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway#supported-configurations.
